description: This file defines multiple utility objects implementing Android's ActivityResultContract interface to handle diverse activity results, such as file choosing, storage location selection, note exporting and restoring, and camera picture capturing in an Android app.

classes.name: ChooseFilesContract
classes.description: Handles intent creation and result parsing for selecting multiple files (images, videos, audio).

classes.name: StorageLocationContract
classes.description: Handles intent creation and result parsing for selecting a directory storage location.

classes.name: ExportNotesContract
classes.description: Handles intent creation and result parsing for exporting notes as a ZIP file.

classes.name: RestoreNotesContract
classes.description: Handles intent creation and result parsing for restoring notes from a ZIP file.

classes.name: TakePictureContract
classes.description: Handles intent creation and result parsing for capturing a picture with the camera into a specified URI.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Constructs intents for different activities such as opening documents, selecting directories, creating files, and capturing images.

methods.name: parseResult
methods.description: Processes activity results to extract relevant data, such as URIs or a success boolean.
